test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Δ ABC is a right angled triangle. ∠A = 90 degree, AB = 4 cm, BC = 5 cm. What is the value of cos B + cot C?
solution:
Given:

ΔABC is right-angled at A

AB = 4 cm, BC = 5 cm

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/928629e24b16a8561d85d478fd6a61def66bd16642400934549a45e545abe1d7.png] 

⇒ CA² = BC² - AB²

⇒ CA2 = 52 - 42

⇒ CA = 3

Cot C = Adjacent/Opposite = CA/AB = 3/4

Cos B = Adjacent/Hypotenuse = AB/BC = 4/5

⇒ cos B + cot C

⇒ 4/5 + 3/4

⇒ (16 + 15)/20

⇒ 31/20

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
